subject: Rebaseline request: MAP & evaluation window after procurement delay
messages:
From: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@helixhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Helix Procurement <procurement@helixhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Delay on SOC2 review — need to rebaseline MAP and close date

Grace —

Quick note from procurement: our SOC2 auditor pushed the evidence window out by two weeks, so legal/procurement won't sign the SOW by the previously agreed close date (7/8). That shifts our internal approval runway.

Can you send an updated MAP and proposed new close timelines (including acceptance window) so we can align with our CFO? Also flag any options you have for credit or support to bridge the delay — that will help the CFO decision.

I can jump on a short call if needed; procurement would like to keep momentum.

Thanks,
Samir
Director, Vendor Management
Helix Health

Attachment: Helix_Q2_budget.pdf (summary)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Delay on SOC2 review — need to rebaseline MAP and close date

Samir —

Thanks for the heads up and for the context. Sorry to hear the SOC2 window slipped — we have three quick levers to keep momentum:

1) Rebaseline MAP with a conservative acceptance window (proposal below).
2) Short advisory/priority onboarding session from our implementation team to compress evaluation time.
3) A commercial bridge (credit or extended support) for finance to consider — looping Ben.

Proposed near-term MAP changes (draft attached):
- New target go-live sign-off: 2026-07-22 to 2026-07-28 (one-week acceptance window).
- Internal checkpoints: weekly sync on integration blockers (Tuesdays, 30m).
- Canary: 48–72 hour canary starting in the acceptance window for production validation.

I've attached a draft MAP (MAP_v3.xlsx) and asked Marissa to update the evaluation plan with compressed checkpoints. Ben — can you confirm what level of one-time commercial concession we can offer if procurement needs a visible credit to the CFO?

If helpful, we can do a 20–30 minute call Monday to finalize.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0142

Attachment: MAP_v3.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@helixhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Delay on SOC2 review — need to rebaseline MAP and close date

Grace / Samir —

I can approve a one-time commercial concession up to 10% of the first-year subscription as a gesture, or alternatively an additional two months of premium support at no charge. Two quick asks before I sign off:

- Procurement to confirm the specific blocker(s) the SOC2 auditor flagged (we need that for risk & revenue ops).
- A short cost-impact note from sales ops (I can draft a one-liner for finance).

If procurement wants a larger credit, I'll need Legal looped for precedent and approval.

Ben
VP, Commercials | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@helixhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 10:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Delay on SOC2 review — need to rebaseline MAP and close date

Team —

I've updated the evaluation plan to compress validation while keeping quality gates. Key changes (eval_plan_v2.docx attached):
- Day 0 (post-SOW): fast-track integration checklist (network, firewall rules, test dataset ingestion).
- Day 3–7: integration smoke tests + automated performance baseline (latency/throughput).
- Day 8–14: functional eval (10 representative prompts + regression tests).
- Day 15–21: canary in production (small subset of users, K/V cache validation).

If procurement can confirm SOC2 evidence window target (date), I can shift checkpoints earlier by removing buffer days. Also recommend we plan a parallel fallback: enable a quantized model variant for initial traffic if the production variant requires extra tuning — that reduces service onboarding risk.

I'll send a consolidated timeline PDF after Ben confirms the commercial approach.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachment: eval_plan_v2.docx
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidated rebaseline & next steps (MAP v3)

Samir —

Attached is the consolidated MAP and the compressed evaluation schedule. Summary for your CFO and procurement:

- New target acceptance window: 2026-07-22 to 2026-07-28 (one-week window).
- Canary: 2026-07-22 to 2026-07-24 (48–72 hours).
- Commercial bridge: 10% of first year (Ben has approved) OR two months premium support — whichever procurement prefers.
- Documents: MAP_v3.xlsx, eval_plan_v2.docx.
- Next step: Procurement confirms SOC2 evidence completion date and signs the updated SOW via DocuSign. Link to draft SOW & MAP: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-helix-MAP

If that timeline works, we can send the DocuSign package today and schedule the onboarding cadence (Marissa will own checkpoints). Please reply with a short confirmation from procurement and we will route the credit through finance.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping this on track.

Best,
Grace

From: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@helixhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Helix Procurement <procurement@helixhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidated rebaseline & next steps (MAP v3)

Grace / team —

Confirming procurement will target SOC2 evidence submission by 7/8; internal sign-off expected by 7/12. The new acceptance window (7/22–7/28) is acceptable to the CFO.

We will sign the updated SOW via DocuSign once issued. Two quick asks before we finalize:

1) Can you send the SOC2 evidence summary (high-level controls mapped) for our auditor?
2) Any immediate tuning recommendations from your infra team (KV cache/latency) that we can run during canary? a short checklist would be helpful.

Appreciate the quick responses here — will confirm when procurement uploads the evidence.

Regards,
Samir

Attachment requested: SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf
